summary.text: Hans Wilz is a Republican state representative for Iowa House District 25 and has served in the Iowa House since 2023.

paragraphs.text: The Iowa Legislature's 2023 biography says Wilz owned a family-owned retail business in Ottumwa for 30 years, was born in 1965 in Ottumwa, and has a bachelor's degree from the University of Northern Iowa.
It lists Wilz as an advisory board member of the Indian Hills Community College Regional Entrepreneurship Center.
